roots.text_en: Every plant has roots beneath the soil — moments that grew quietly before 1 November 2024, when we finally chose each other.
roots.text_id: Setiap tanaman punya akar di bawah tanah — momen-momen yang tumbuh diam-diam sebelum 1 November 2024, ketika kita akhirnya memilih satu sama lain.

memories.caption_en: A memory from our journey — miles apart, hearts together.
memories.caption_id: Kenangan dari perjalanan kita — terpisah jarak, hati bersatu.

memories.caption_en: The day we began — two hearts, miles apart, choosing each other anyway.
memories.caption_id: Hari kita mulai — dua hati, terpisah jarak, tetap memilih satu sama lain.

memories.caption_en: The months before — conversations, laughs, and a feeling that kept growing.
memories.caption_id: Bulan-bulan sebelumnya — percakapan, tawa, dan perasaan yang terus tumbuh.

memories.caption_id: Tambahkan kenangan paling awal di sini — sapaan pertama, senyum pertama.
